selection_note: General historical topics chosen from observed gaps on the public development paper. These are encyclopedia articles, not exam solutions. Selection has seen the development questions; evaluation is not held out.
transform: Exact paragraph/sentence spans; title and section prefixes; omit bibliography/navigation; no generated facts or exam answer keys
quality_limit: Provenance and passage boundaries verified; encyclopedia claims are not independently fact-checked
verification: Every indexed passage matches its exact article span plus title/section prefix; unique IDs and canonical titles; no secondary splitting
